title: Frontend: Software project milestone template wizard step
description: The milestone template selection step within the create project wizard, specifically for software projects. Shows predefined milestones with descriptions that users can check/uncheck.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists 7 predefined milestones as styled checkboxes with descriptions
User can uncheck any they don't want
Selected templates are passed to the project creation API call

steps.details: Create src/components/projects/MilestoneTemplatesStep.tsx. Show list of PREDEFINED_SOFTWARE_MILESTONES as Checkbox + Label pairs with descriptions. Initialize all as checked. Pass selected array up to parent via onChange prop.
In step 3 of wizard: if type === 'software', render MilestoneTemplatesStep. Otherwise, render a 'Ready to create!' confirmation message.
Select 'software' type, reach step 3 — verify templates shown. Uncheck 2 — verify only selected templates created on submit.
